leadText:
Marcel (Japanese: マッキー McKee) is a character of the day who appeared in The Garden of Eatin.

The director of the Banana Slakoth Garden, Marcel was in the middle of a big problem when and showed up. The Garden had been closed due to a eating all of the bananas in the park, and incidentally scaring off and starving all of its resident .

Marcel was just about to give up hope, but after a video call through to , he learned that a Pokémon with an Ability like would overcome Snorlax's sleep-inducing attack. Taking his advice, Marcel used a Slakoth to defeat Ash's , , and , which resulted in it evolving into a . Using the , Marcel battled the Snorlax and successfully it.

After re-opening the park, Marcel revealed that Snorlax had given him an idea. One of the rooms was designed for visitors to sleep if they were feeling tired, and Marcel's newly caught Snorlax helped them fall asleep using Yawn.
